source_contract.measurement_space: PDF-vector point centres; source-crop pixels for gallery hit-testing

preflight.reason: Figure 5a is a spatial dot map with categorical and continuous colour encodings, not a registered filled-contour map.
preflight.candidate_workflow: Direct recovery of visually verified, vector-drawn circle marks; no XY axis calibration was applied.

visible_grammar.coordinate_model: relative map coordinates only; no physical axes are printed

recoverable_representation.left_map: 426 categorical spot centres, fills, and relative positions
recoverable_representation.right_maps: 3424 spot centres and rendered fills across eight displayed cell-type maps
recoverable_representation.colour_values: nearest-CIELAB matches to the printed colourbar, retained only as visible display approximations

limitations: Raw spatial-transcriptomics observations, cell IDs, and physical coordinates.
The authors' underlying probabilistic-mapping values beyond the rendered colour precision.
Any interpolation, model, deconvolution, or communication-analysis parameters.
An isopleth/contour surface: no contour lines or filled contour bands are present in Figure 5a.
review_required: Visually inspect figure5a_vector_spot_overlay.png before treating the colour-derived values as usable display estimates.
